findings: Withdraw Warning skips AlertDialog confirmation: the plan requires 'Withdraw button (AlertDialog + calls withdrawWarning)' but the button in AdminUserDetail.tsx fires handleWithdrawWarning() immediately on click. An empty AlertDialog shell exists with the comment 'Intentionally empty – withdraw runs immediately on button click, no extra dialog needed', which explicitly contradicts the requirement. A confirm dialog must be added before calling withdrawWarning().

AdminEventsTab category dot always renders as muted: getCategoryDot is called with a hardcoded undefined argument (line 354) instead of event.category, so every row in the events list gets the fallback bg-muted-foreground color. Fix: change getCategoryDot(undefined) to getCategoryDot(event.category).
